headerSubtitle: Export the signing certificate iLoader already uses for LiveContainer as a .p12 file.
accountsMissing: No saved iLoader account found. Run this as the same Windows user and select Refresh.
p12PasswordHint: Required to import the certificate. Keep it safe.
localFirstHint: The certificate is fetched from Apple with the credentials iLoader saved; a verification code is asked only when Apple requires one.
errorFooterHint: The operation did not finish. See the details above.
twoFactorHint: Enter the 6-digit code from a trusted device or an SMS.
validationPassword: Set a password for the .p12 file.
messageAccountsErrorHint: Check the details, then refresh the list.
messageNoAccountsHint: Run this as the same Windows user as iLoader, then select Refresh.
messageReadyHint: Account loaded. Set the file password and folder, then start.
messageDone: Certificate saved. Keep the file and its password private.
messageCancelled: Export stopped. Enter the file password again to retry.
messageFailedHint: Check the account and network, then retry.
messageWaiting: Enter the code from your trusted device or SMS.
stageAuthenticating: Signing in with the saved account
chooseFolderTitle: Choose a folder for the certificate
certExpired: Certificate expired or not yet valid; {dates}
certUnverified: Certificate status unknown, revocation not confirmed; {dates}
errInvalidRequest: Check the saved account, file password and folder.
errWindowsOnly: Export is supported on Windows only.
errHelperMissing: The export helper is missing. Keep it next to the app.
errStorage: No iLoader private key for this account. Sign with iLoader under this Windows user first.
errSavedCredentials: No local match, and iLoader did not save this account password. Save credentials in iLoader or add a matching .mobileprovision.
errAuthentication: Could not fetch the certificate with the saved account. Check the network, trusted devices or iLoader's account state.
errTwoFactor: The verification code was interrupted or rejected. Export again.
errCertificates: Could not read the Apple developer certificates. Check the network and account state.
errNoMatch: No valid certificate matches the local iLoader key. Certificates may be expired or revoked; this tool never creates or revokes them.
errEncode: Could not package the certificate and key as a P12.
errOutput: Could not save the P12. Check the folder's write permission and free space.
errInternal: The export helper hit an internal error.
errNoDataDir: Cannot find the iLoader user data folder.
errAccountRead: Cannot read the saved iLoader accounts.
errAccountFormat: The saved iLoader account list has an unexpected format.
errHelperPath: The export helper path is not valid.
errHelperComm: Cannot set up communication with the export helper.
errHelperStart: Cannot start the export helper. Check that the files are complete.
errHelperSend: Cannot send the request to the export helper.
errHelperProtocol: The export helper sent data this app cannot read.
errTwoFactorMissing: This account needs a two-factor code, but no prompt could be shown.
errHelperSendCode: Cannot send the verification code to the export helper.
errHelperResult: The export helper returned an invalid file path.
errHelperExit: The export helper stopped before confirming the export.
